test.create_query: CREATE TABLE parts_many (UserID UInt64, CounterID UInt32, EventDate Date, EventTime DateTime, WatchID UInt64, RegionID UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY intHash32(UserID) % 5000 ORDER BY (CounterID, EventDate, intHash32(UserID), EventTime)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO parts_many SELECT UserID, CounterID, EventDate, EventTime, WatchID, RegionID FROM hits_100m_single WHERE intHash32(UserID) % 2 = 0 SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, min_insert_block_size_rows = 1000000000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_block_size = 1000000000, max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
